This PR does not accomplish the stated goal of making the test suite pass. It replaces test_larger_floor passing with test_quarterly_floor_plan passing—still 8/9 tests. The PR explicitly acknowledges this: "❌ test_larger_floor (allocation mismatch)". 

More critically, the PR implements the Largest Remainder method "only so that test_quarterly_floor_plan passes" (per its own description), despite acknowledging this contradicts the D'Hondt algorithm in the docstring and breaks test_larger_floor. This is test-specific logic that doesn't solve the underlying problem.

The correct approach is to only add validation and fix the "return all teams" bug (which would pass 8/9 tests, failing only test_quarterly_floor_plan), then investigate which test has an incorrect expected value, since both test_quarterly_floor_plan and test_larger_floor cannot both be satisfied by the documented D'Hondt method.
